adds.name: wire count
adds.meaning: The number of wires (roles), scratch wires included, of the fixed exchange network; also the number of row streams a call is split into.

adds.name: label dimension
adds.meaning: The dimension of the label space, equal to the number of $b$-digit fields in each chunk.

adds.name: smaller calls
adds.meaning: The sum of the ranks of all edge differences, which is the number of smaller interchanges one network run makes.

adds.name: chunk width
adds.meaning: The width, in digits, of each of the two chunks, a power $m^k$ of $m$.

adds.name: bank size
adds.meaning: The number of indices $a$ of each data bank, so each bank holds $N$ wires.

adds.name: ground-set size
adds.meaning: The size ($h=100$) of the set whose three-element subsets index the banks.
